create_logger_for_rl_training: create a Logger instance to log training and eval metrics to CSV and TensorBoard
use_log_and_dump_context: use the LogAndDumpCtx context manager to batch log metrics then dump them at exit
log_metrics_dict_to_csv: log a dictionary of metrics to CSV and TensorBoard using log_metrics with a step number
create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter to track running averages by calling update then value
dump_metrics_to_console_and_csv: dump accumulated train or eval metrics to console and CSV using Logger dump
